head: fork

doc_clean.rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams, (E)/(U) units >= 5 grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%, or both df >= 10, or eval df >= 100 (templates); reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
doc_clean.filter: drop every row train.doc_overlap_guard.scan FAILS over the whole set

heldout_excluded.reason: train.heldout (D1-B, k=8) finds the 4-word fragment 'rather than relying on' of template soft_framing in these three MMLU aux_train records (natural text, no injection; the PR #44 build guard, word 6-grams, does not fire). Excluded from the draw, fail-closed: the heldout phase passes only if the full-set hits are exactly these ids (2026-10-06 local scan, 150,000 texts, 112 s).

execution_note: job-tvuat (jobs/cell_step_profile, rule v1-A2, PR #86 @54ee89d) ADOPT: chosen ckpt_rows_lean = per-block activation checkpointing keeping the cache fork, the step's 8 rows batched in length-sorted groups (<= 8 rows, <= 8,192 padded tokens per call; long rows split a step into several groups), chunked_lean WKV (our pure-PyTorch rearrangement of the vendored chunked WKV, CPU-equivalence-tested; no GPU gate needed); measured median step 8.25 s, 0 OOMs, projection 1,382 steps / 11,056 rows in 190 min (receipt receipts/2026-10-07-D-cell-step-profile-tvuat). max_minutes_note: training wall-clock inside the 230-min cell phase: 230 - load/draw/tokenize ~10 - smoke+ladder ~10 - two dev cards ~10 - checkpoints/margin 10 = 190 (pre-registered); cumulative over restarts (train_clock in cell.json)
